knowledge.textEn: Prepare 12 claim descriptors spanning main, pull requests, production environment and a reusable workflow. Identify who controls repository, environment and workflow reference, using no live token.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 雲端信任條件必須與實際subject樣板一致；environment不能被推論成分支仍在subject內。固定workflow版本與受眾條件分開檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Cloud trust conditions must match the actual subject template. An environment context does not imply the branch remains encoded in the subject. Verify pinned workflow identity and audience independently.

quiz.question: 「GitHub OIDC · 信任契約與反例資料」：哪一項提供依證據採取處置或重新驗證的條件？
quiz.questionEn: GitHub OIDC · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 雲端信任條件必須與實際subject樣板一致；environment不能被推論成分支仍在subject內。固定workflow版本與受眾條件分開檢查。
先離線驗證新舊樣板，安排受控切換並保留上一個明確核准版本；將environment保護規則列為外部相依，不宣稱claim本身完成所有審批。
GitHub OIDC提供工作流程來源claims，subject的內容會受環境及自訂樣板影響；本課驗證受信任部署者的精確組合。
optionsEn: Cloud trust conditions must match the actual subject template. An environment context does not imply the branch remains encoded in the subject. Verify pinned workflow identity and audience independently.

Validate old and new templates offline before a controlled cutover, retaining the previous explicitly approved revision. Treat environment-protection rules as an external dependency, not something a claim alone proves.

GitHub OIDC supplies workflow-origin claims, while environment selection and custom templates affect subject composition. This case verifies the precise combination identifying an approved deployment workflow.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。先離線驗證新舊樣板，安排受控切換並保留上一個明確核准版本；將environment保護規則列為外部相依，不宣稱claim本身完成所有審批。 與本階段判準一起判讀：為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Validate old and new templates offline before a controlled cutover, retaining the previous explicitly approved revision. Treat environment-protection rules as an external dependency, not something a claim alone proves. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.

steps.title: GitHub OIDC · 信任契約與反例資料 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: GitHub OIDC · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「GitHub OIDC · 信任契約與反例資料」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for GitHub OIDC · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付12列workflow-contract.csv、兩版subject對照與核准SHA清單；交接包含受眾、issuer及repo限制的負責人。
在交接件中加入「GitHub OIDC · 信任契約與反例資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：製作12筆main、pull request、production environment與重用workflow的claim描述；畫出repo、environment、workflow reference各自由誰控制，不使用真實token。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver 12 workflow-contract rows, both subject representations and approved SHAs. The handover identifies owners of audience, issuer and repository restrictions, with no deployment credentials included.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for GitHub OIDC · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures: Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Prepare 12 claim descriptors spanning main, pull requests, production environment and a reusable workflow. Identify who controls repository, environment and workflow reference, using no live token. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
steps.checkEn: Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.
